sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò yào zuò.
sentences.english_hint: I have a lot of work to do.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you are busy this week.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the incomplete sentence about having lots of work at 00:19.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí yào wèn.
sentences.english_hint: I have a question to ask.
sentences.scenario: Speak up during a lesson or meeting.
sentences.source_note: Analysis gives this variation to reinforce the core work sentence pattern.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì fēng yóujiàn yào xiě.
sentences.english_hint: I have an email to write.
sentences.scenario: Describe a task you need to finish at work.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this practical work variation.

sentences.scenario: Ask someone to repeat a question.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the repetition request at 05:45; 再 placement recurs elsewhere.

sentences.scenario: Try reading a Chinese sentence again.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated verb-order errors at 10:25 and 31:39.

sentences.english_hint: How do you read this character?
sentences.scenario: Ask about a character you cannot pronounce.
sentences.source_note: Analysis recommends this phrase for recurring character-reading difficulty.

sentences.chinese: 我知道意思，但是忘了怎么读。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yìsi, dànshì wàng le zěnme dú.
sentences.english_hint: I know the meaning, but forgot how to read it.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you hesitate over a familiar character.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this phrase; the learner repeatedly recognizes meanings without recalling pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 这个玩具是在中国生产的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège wánjù shì zài Zhōngguó shēngchǎn de.
sentences.english_hint: This toy was made in China.
sentences.scenario: Describe where a toy was made.
sentences.source_note: Analysis shortens the correction about the daughter's toys into this model.

sentences.english_hint: How do you use this air conditioner?
sentences.scenario: Ask your host how to use the air conditioner.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the learner's question during the London accommodation story at 25:47.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bù néng mǎshàng lái bāng nǐ.
sentences.english_hint: They can't come help you right away.
sentences.scenario: Explain that help will take time to arrive.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 帮忙你 to 帮你 in the travel discussion at 29:17.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de.
sentences.english_hint: This table is made of wood.
sentences.scenario: Describe the material of a table.
sentences.source_note: Analysis provides this model for the lesson's discussion of materials.

sentences.chinese: 手机除了能打电话，还能拍照。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī chúle néng dǎ diànhuà, hái néng pāizhào.
sentences.english_hint: A phone can take photos as well as make calls.
sentences.scenario: Name two things a phone can do.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this drill based on the discussion of phone functions.

sentences.scenario: Explain that product priorities depend on the situation.
sentences.source_note: Uses the first clause of the analysis correction at 01:19:18, removing unnecessary 是.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān hái méiyǒu dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english_hint: I haven't made a call today yet.
sentences.scenario: Say whether you have used your phone for calls today.
sentences.source_note: Builds on successful 还没有 usage in the learner's phone discussion at 01:17.
